items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: He was also a drummer too I used to work with by the name of Red Dugas.

ctx.x: That's why we were trying to put you on the spot, but we were trying to wonder sort of what style, you know, he plays and all.
Well, Buddy Petite was like a leader in the trumpet field. The guys used to follow him. He was also a drummer too I used to work with by the name of Red Dugas. You ever heard of him?
